summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG; its active playable place is Z01, Broken Lantern Road, from the Wayside Fire to the Bailiff's Dripping Gate arena. The place referee stages quests and actors, player/enemy behaviors resolve combat, and authored scene cells plus procedural generators build the ravine; a database-backed front door manages Bearers and realms while HUD and shop UI read player/place state.
places: places/main/ - active Z01 place: Wayside Fire, candle road, tollhouse court, Dripping Gate and Bailiff arena; sim.js coordinates quest progress, NPCs, petitions and actors.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored camp, candle-road and tollhouse-court landmarks and dressing.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - authored extended road, Dripping Gate and Bailiff arena dressing.
places/main/config.yaml - main-place terrain, materials and procedural vegetation layers.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: default place main, player/camera templates, lighting, UI, arrival behavior, nametag and desktop/touch input actions.
templates/player.js - player character template composing scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - place referee: ensures camp NPCs, petitions, enemy pack and Bailiff exist; advances quests, levels and turn-in reward.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored Wayside Fire and candle-road/court content.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - authored gate, extended road and Bailiff arena content.
places/main/config.yaml - binds main-place terrain and environmental layers.
scripts/arrival.js - world doorway behavior; saves an active Bearer's main-place state on leave.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and position packing; used by player and arrival behavior.
scripts/db.js - characters table migration: owner/realm/name/class/level/zone plus JSON save; unique live names per realm.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - per-account character cap and realm room/name registry used by player menus and UI.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml - runtime drop, quest payout, buyback and Oswin stock/prices shared by sim, enemy payout and shop.
scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denomination formatting and coin HTML shared by HUD, shop and enemy payout.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - shared hero, enemy, skill, guard and Bailiff tuning consumed by player, wax-pack and boss.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared HUB/ROAD/COURTS/GATE coordinates and floorDist reference used by terrain, player path/boundary logic and layout.
scripts/gen/hub-kit.js, scripts/gen/vf-kit.js and scripts/gen/shapes.js - reusable modeling helpers for camp, road and arena generators.
notableExports: scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove
scripts/camera.js - onInput, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave
scripts/petition.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update; scripts/terrain.js - heightAt, materialAt
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields: combat stats, tonics, XP/level, copper, kills/shards/bag/petitions, quest/claims, weapon and ancestry/class; position is packed separately.
scripts/player.js - active body's movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers plus menu/selection scratch; hydrates/saves the selected Bearer, not the character table itself.
places/main/sim.js - per-player Z01 stage/dialog/kills baseline and claimed turn-in reward; place orchestration and NPC/shop-open distance behavior.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and nearby eligible Bearers' XP/copper/kills/shards payouts.
scripts/bailiff.js - boss hp/phases/casts, arena reset, ledger pillars/walkers and Fray; publishes place.state.boss and bailiffDownAt.
scripts/lib/shop.js - trade validation and mutations to buyer's copper, tonics, bag and maxHp; shop state is carried by player.state.
scripts/camera.js - camera zoom and eased follow; uses target.state.menu and menu-shot.yml for menu framing and enteredAt for arrival crane.
scripts/ui.js - renders menu, HUD, dialogue, inventory and boss/shop panels from state; scripts/ui/nametag.js suppresses tags while a body is in menu.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches scripts/player.js through templates/player.js and maps desktop/touch actions; UI menu buttons send menu action data → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout actions.

scripts/player.js menuInput → scripts/lib/character.js roster/create/load/remove using caller-owned characters rows; realms.yml maps chosen realm to room, and selected Bearer fields hydrate player.state.

While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and attempts to cross to room veil only when places/veil/config.yaml exists; realms/character screens remain state-driven, not a separate place in this tree.

scripts/ui.js draws title, realms, character select/create and HUD from player.state → menu actions are deduplicated by player.js; camera.js reads target.state.menu and menu-shot.yml for the menu shot.
player.js saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus position every 20 seconds and on rest → character.js writes characters; arrival.js onLeave also saves an active character leaving main.
scripts/player.js uses veilfall-map.js floorDist for reachable click goals and floor-constrained movement/dash → the hero stays on the defined walkable floor.
player.js strikes mutate enemy.state.hp/lastHit → wax-pack.js resolves ordinary deaths and nearby player payouts from economy.yml; Bailiff reuses wax-pack payout on defeat.
wax-pack.js and bailiff.js test player iframe/guard fields before damage; caught guard writes riposte → player.js guardTick performs the riposte reaction.
bailiff.js spawns phase-II ledger pillars/walkers and publishes hp/max/phase/engaged/dead/fray/ledgers/cast to place.state.boss → scripts/ui.js renders boss bar and guidance.
bailiff.js marks eligible present players bossKilled and sets place.state.bailiffDownAt → places/main/sim.js advances the stage-gated quest and grants its once-per-character reward.
places/main/sim.js spawns petition objects with scripts/petition.js → trigger entry at quest stage 2 records petition IDs in player state; five advance the quest.
Talking to Oswin sets player.state.shop in places/main/sim.js → scripts/ui.js renders shopPanel; shop actions route player.js → shopInput validates economy.yml trades and mutates buyer state.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props, varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share scripts/gen/hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks and clutter, varied by parameters/seeds and built with scripts/gen/vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - reused for road and arena broken ashlar walls and iron braziers; params.kind selects wall/brazier, dimensions and seed vary geometry.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js.
scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - shared wax character mesh for ordinary pilgrims/deacons and Bailiff, varied by kind and seed.
scripts/grass.js, scripts/clover.js and scripts/mushroom.js - procedural vegetation scatter layers configured in places/main/config.yaml; grass appearance uses scripts/grass-look.js.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is exactly scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; transient player.state (menu, active targeting/movement, dialogue/shop UI) is not saved. Keep new character fields in CHAR_KEYS to survive swaps and saves.

Character rows are caller-owned and realm-bound; character.js scopes roster/load/save by owner and realm, while live names are unique within a realm. realms.yml room IDs are routing identities, not additional places present in this tree.
Player attacks directly mutate enemy.state.hp; ordinary-enemy death, XP and kill credit are resolved later by wax-pack.js. Preserve that handoff and its menu/charId eligibility check.
Quest stage, killsAt, petition IDs and claimed rewards are per-character; petition triggers count only at stage 2 and ITEM-001 is guarded by claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'].
Boss HUD consumes place.state.boss projection (including fray and ledgers), not boss internals; preserve published fields when changing boss behavior.
Money is one integer player.state.copper (100 copper = 1 silver, 100 silver = 1 gold); drop/shop/quest numbers live in economy.yml.
